query: Design a design system for a B2B SaaS dashboard product. The brand should feel premium and technical, not playful.
expected_behavior: Identifies the product users, frequent dashboard task, and evidence or assumptions relevant to the request before choosing visual foundations
Provides a usable color system with semantic roles and checks applicable WCAG 2.2 AA contrast; color notation is not treated as a success criterion
Defines typography and spacing scales that fit the product content without requiring a particular mathematical ratio
Names an appropriate brand register or style direction only insofar as it supports the supplied premium technical brief
Avoids inventing product facts and gives a concrete way to assess whether the system supports the task
